metadata.title: Defense Tech: Investors and Operators, 6th Palm Beach CorpGov Forum

content.text:
CorpGov hosted the sixth annual Palm Beach CorpGov Forum on Nov. 4-5, 2026, at the Palm Beach Lake Pavilion and The Cove Club, both located waterfront with sweeping views of Palm Beach Island, along with a reception at Cucina Palm Beach. The panel called "Defense Tech: Investors and Operators" took place on Thursday morning.
The panel featured Andrew Bair, President and CEO of Capital Defense Technologies, Marcos Cervantes, Founder and CEO at Q-Branch, and Joseph Yaker, Founder and CEO of Xpand Global Inc. Jarrett Banks, Editor-at-Large of CorpGov, moderated the discussion.
Key comments from the panel:
-
"And that's really, in my view, the big sea change is it's new Silicon Valley resources, thinking, innovation, et cetera, now entering the defense industrial base," said Andrew Bair.
-
"Don't give me your money," stated Marcos Cervantes. "Put your money in defense and national security because that means economic security."
-
"Without private investments, there's no defense tech, and let's not make mistakes about it," said Joseph Yaker. "There's not enough money coming out of government that will sustain the real new technology that's coming out there in the field."
-
"And speaking of some of these legacy companies, I'm just curious, are we looking at a future where these next gen fighter pilots are obsolete?" said Jarrett Banks.
